from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":94,"var":"domain","code":"if (idn2_to_ascii_lz(domain, &out, flags[it]) == IDN2_OK)","note":"The fuzzer feeds attacker-controlled bytes into the locale-aware ASCII lookup API."},
{"step":2,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_to_ascii_lz","line":0,"var":"src","code":"rc = idn2_lookup_u8 (src, lookupname, flags);","note":"The locale string is forwarded into the UTF-8 lookup implementation."},
{"step":3,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_lookup_u8","line":431,"var":"src","code":"rc = _tr46 (src, &out, flags);","note":"TR46 mapping is enabled by default and transforms the attacker-controlled domain before label validation."},
{"step":4,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"_tr46","line":303,"var":"domain_u32","code":"domain_u32 = u8_to_u32 (domain_u8, u8_strlen (domain_u8) + 1, NULL, &len);","note":"The UTF-8 input is expanded into a UTF-32 buffer that preserves the crafted label contents."},
{"step":5,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"_tr46","line":313,"var":"ace","code":"ace = u32_to_u8 (s + 4, e - s - 4, NULL, &ace_len);","note":"For xn-- labels, the code converts the punycode payload back to UTF-8 for decoding and validation."},
{"step":6,"file":"lib/puny_decode.c","function":"_idn2_punycode_decode","line":166,"var":"output_length","code":"/* decode punycode digits into output code points */","note":"The crafted payload reaches the punycode decoder, which is the sanitizer/runtime sink that reports the uninitialized-value bug."},
{"step":7,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"_tr46","line":313,"var":"name_u32","code":"rc = _idn2_punycode_decode (ace_len, (char *) ace, &name_len, name_u32);","note":"The decoded label is then revalidated; the bug is triggered during this decode step on attacker-controlled data."},
{"step":8,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_lookup_u8","line":449,"var":"_lookupname","code":"memcpy (_lookupname + lookupnamelen, tmp, tmplen);","note":"If validation succeeds, the normalized label is copied into the fixed-size output buffer for the final domain name."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
print('updated trace')
